title: duplicate TokenBucket type in rate_limit and peering/rate_limit
description: crates/transit/src/rate_limit.rs and crates/transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs both define a TokenBucket struct and a PeerRateLimiter. The top-level variant is keyed by IpAddr; the peering variant is keyed by String (address with port), giving different per-IP isolation semantics. Two independent implementations diverge silently. Extract one canonical implementation and delete the duplicate.
